# Tensile

> Tensile is Huginn Tech's open-source explorer for Celestia Fibre. It follows blob settlements, publishers and validators in real time, and checks that every validator serves the rows it endorsed.

The public JSON API is read-only and needs no key. Base URLs: https://tensile.huginn.tech/api/v1 (mainnet) and https://tensile-mocha.huginn.tech/api/v1 (Mocha testnet). /v1/meta carries the data license and the credit line.

## Docs

- [API reference](https://tensile.huginn.tech/api/): every endpoint with its parameters and an example response
- [Methodology](https://tensile.huginn.tech/methodology/): how every figure is computed
- [Source code](https://github.com/Huginn-Tech/tensile): Apache-2.0
